info.title: Workflow Management API
info.description:
Create, manage, publish, execute and debug workflows (flows). A workflow is a directed ACYCLIC graph: nodes (agents, functions, integrations, ...) connected by edges. Nodes with no incoming edges all start immediately in parallel; a graph with no edges runs every node simultaneously. The server does NOT detect cycles — nodes in a cycle never run.

Data references (JSONPath, resolved in node payloads): $.trigger (run input), $.static (static vars), $.context (run context vars), $.env.auth_token / $.env.run_id / $.env.headers, $.<NODE_ID> (full output of an upstream node), $.<NODE_ID>.result (an agent node's answer). JSONPath is NOT resolved in static-node payloads (literals only) or inside eval-node code (only eval params values are resolved).

Node ids must match ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_:]*$ and must not be: trigger, static, RESOLVE_ERROR, RESOLVE_SUCCESS.

Typical build sequence: GET /hub/collections (or POST to create one) -> discover subjects via GET /compute/functions and GET /hub/quiva-endpoints -> POST /hub/workflows (draft) -> POST /hub/workflows/publish -> POST /hub/workflows/run. Debug with GET /hub/workflows/errored, GET /hub/workflows/paused and POST /hub/run-logs/search. Test payload fragments first with POST /hub/test-jpath, /hub/test-eval, /hub/test-http.

get.description: Workflows live inside a collection. Returns collection subjects needed by createWorkflow.

200.description: List of collections: { results: [{ subject, name, description }], resultsTotal }

parameters.name: collection_topic
parameters.description: Last segment of the collection subject, e.g. '2408930879'

200.description: { results: [{ subject, name, description, modified }], resultsTotal }

post.description: Creates a draft workflow in a collection. Publish it to make it executable. Server-side validation (validate=true) checks: duplicate/reserved/invalid node ids, missing payloads, edges referencing missing nodes, and that function/flow subjects exist. It does NOT check for cycles.

value.name: Code Expert
value.description: Writes a JS snippet, cleans it up, posts it to Slack

agent.name: code_expert
agent.behaviour: You write concise javascript. Return only the function.

201.description: Created. Returns the workflow including its draft subject (ms.hub.config.workflow.draft.{collection}.{flow}) needed for publish.

409.description: Workflow name already used within this collection

get.description: Fetch a workflow's full config (nodes, edges, static, result). Path segments are the last two parts of the workflow subject.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: true = draft version, false = published version

patch.description: Partial update (only provided fields change). Updating a published workflow creates a new draft — publish again to make changes live.

parameters.name: keep_draft
parameters.description: true removes only the published version

post.description: Makes the workflow executable and wires up any schedule triggers.

200.description: Published. The runnable subject is ms.hub.config.workflow.{collection}.{flow} (drop the '.draft.' segment - the response may only contain a success message).

post.description: Run a published workflow. await=true returns results synchronously; await=false returns a tracking_id immediately. Resume a paused (input/human-in-the-loop) run by passing its run_id plus the human response as trigger.

200.description: Run result. { tracking_id, result }. If config.result was set, result matches that JSONPath selection; otherwise result is the step-by-step log array where items with a 'paused': true flag indicate a human-in-the-loop pause (resume with run_id).

404.description: Workflow not found or not published

get.description: Runs waiting on human input. Each entry includes the run_id and the paused node's message; resume via runWorkflow.
Runs that ended in an error, including the failing node id and lookup state at failure.

conditions.description: ANDed conditions over indexed fields: run_id, flow_topic, collection_topic, status (success|error|paused|in_progress), session_id, error, draft

get.description: Discover function subjects (ms.compute.*) referenced by function nodes in data.subject.
Discover endpoint subjects referenced by quiva-endpoint nodes in data.subject.

post.description: Resolve a JSONPath expression or template object against sample lookup data using the real engine resolver. Use before building node payloads.

path.description: JSONPath string or template object, e.g. "$.trigger.email"

code.description: JavaScript expression, as in an eval node

params.description: Named params usable in code; values may be JSONPath resolved against lookup

lookup.description: Optional lookup data for resolving $.X references in params values
Optional lookup data for resolving $.X references in the request

collectionTopic.name: collection_topic
collectionTopic.description: Second-to-last segment of the workflow subject

flowTopic.name: flow_topic
flowTopic.description: Last segment of the workflow subject

secrets.description: Secret identifiers used by this workflow

subject.description: Workflow subject. Published: ms.hub.config.workflow.{collection}.{flow} (NO 'published' segment - get it from listWorkflows version=published). Draft: ms.hub.config.workflow.draft.{collection}.{flow}.

trigger.description: Run input, referenced in nodes via $.trigger

triggers.description: Batch execution (use either trigger or triggers)

await.description: true = wait for completion and return results; false = return tracking_id immediately

enable_log.description: Store detailed run logs (searchable via searchRunLogs)

knowledge.description: Knowledge URIs for agents: kv://, obj://, str://, sid://, dta://

session_id.description: Agent conversation continuity; omit for new sessions

run_id.description: Tracking id of a paused run to resume (human-in-the-loop)

WorkflowConfig.description: The execution graph. Must be acyclic (not server-checked). Nodes run in topological order; condition nodes can alter the path.

result.description: JSONPath selecting the run's return value, e.g. '$.FINAL_NODE.result'. Without it the run returns the full step log array.

position.description: Optional visual editor position { x, y }

NodeData.description: Node definition. id: unique, ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_:]*$, not a reserved word (trigger, static, RESOLVE_ERROR, RESOLVE_SUCCESS). payload is REQUIRED on every node type. Reference a node's output downstream via $.{id}.

TriggerNodeData.description: Entry-point metadata for the visual editor. SKIPPED at runtime — optional; run input arrives via the run request 'trigger' field ($.trigger), not through this node.

payload.description: Config varies by trigger_type; {} for manual

AgentNodeData.description: Invoke an LLM agent. The inline definition MUST be nested under payload.agent — flat payloads (api_key/llm_provider/model at payload top level) are silently dropped at runtime and the node fails with 'a subject, node_subject or agent property is required'. IMPORTANT: the node output at $.{id}.result is a JSON-ENCODED STRING even when output_schema is set — add an eval node to JSON.parse it before branching on its fields.

payload.description: One of 'agent' (inline definition), 'subject' (saved agent subject) or 'node_subject' (agent node template) is required. prompt/await live at this level, NOT inside agent.

llm_provider.description: The invoke handler only supports claude/anthropic

output_schema.description: Flat map of field -> short description; forces structured JSON output (still delivered as a JSON string in result)

node_subject.description: Agent node template subject (alternative to inline 'agent')

prompt.description: string or object; supports JSONPath, e.g. 'Summarise |$.trigger.text'. Empty = the raw trigger is used as the prompt.

FunctionNodeData.description: Invoke a compute function. subject is REQUIRED and must exist — discover via GET /compute/functions.

payload.description: Function input (any JSON); JSONPath supported, e.g. '$.PREV_NODE'

response_map.description: Optional JSONPath mapping applied to the function output

IntegrationNodeData.description: HTTP request to a third-party API, optionally via an OAuth connection. Result shape: { status, statusText, headers, data }. 4xx/5xx responses become node errors (tolerate/retry via options).

HttpNodeData.description: Plain HTTP request (no OAuth metadata). Same payload and behaviour as integration.

HttpPayload.description: JSONPath supported in all fields. IMPORTANT: the base URL key is snake_case 'base_url' — a 'baseURL' key is silently ignored.

base_url.description: Joined with url; snake_case, NOT baseURL

FlowNodeData.description: Invoke another published workflow as a sub-flow. subject is REQUIRED and must exist.

subject.description: Sub-workflow subject: ms.hub.config.workflow.{collection}.{flow} (published form, no 'published' segment); must exist

payload.description: Passed as the sub-flow trigger; JSONPath supported

response_map.description: Optional JSONPath mapping over the sub-flow output

EvalNodeData.description: Run a JavaScript expression over named params.

code.description: Plain JavaScript expression — JSONPath is NOT resolved inside code

params.description: Named params usable in code; each VALUE is JSONPath-resolved, e.g. { "c": "$.AGENT.result" }

ConditionNodeData.description: Branching. Evaluates rules and activates the listed node ids; non-selected branches are skipped. Reserved targets: RESOLVE_SUCCESS (end flow ok), RESOLVE_ERROR (fail flow). Any other target must be an existing node id, and you should also add edges from this node to each then/else target.

RulesNodeData.description: Evaluate a rules object against facts/context; output is { <ruleKey>: outcome }.

rules.description: Rules map (same engine as condition nodes)

MapNodeData.description: Reshape data: the payload template is JSONPath-resolved and becomes the node output.

payload.description: Object or array template; string values may be JSONPath references

StaticNodeData.description: Merge literal values into $.static. LITERALS ONLY — JSONPath is not resolved in this payload.

DelayNodeData.description: Pause the branch for time_ms milliseconds. The node type is 'delay' — 'wait' is NOT a valid type (the engine silently ignores it).

ScheduleNodeData.description: Schedule another workflow run for later.

flow_subject.description: Workflow subject to schedule; supports JSONPath

trigger.description: Trigger data for the scheduled run; supports JSONPath

InputNodeData.description: Pause the flow for human input: creates an escalation task (emailing assignees) and pauses. Resume via runWorkflow with the run_id and the human response as trigger — that response becomes this node's output.

HumanInTheLoopNodeData.description: Alias of 'input': pause for human approval/input via an escalation task.

message.description: Prompt for the human; supports JSONPath

assignees.description: Comma-separated user ids; each is notified by email

QuivaEndpointNodeData.description: Invoke a Quiva endpoint. subject is REQUIRED — discover via GET /hub/quiva-endpoints.

payload.description: Passed to the endpoint; JSONPath supported

ErrorNodeData.description: Terminate the flow with an error status code and message.

ignore_response_codes.description: HTTP status codes treated as success

BadRequest.description: Invalid request or validation failure, e.g. { "error": "duplicate node id found: CODE_EXPERT" }
